_about: One Gemini prebuilt voice and acting direction per speaker (tools/voices.mjs). Caricatures are creatures inspired by public personas: the directions describe a style, never a real person. Changing a voice here only affects lines rendered afterwards; delete a speaker's MP3s to re-render them.

narrator.style: The Sundial, an ancient talking stone sundial. A warm, slow, very old voice, kind and gently amused, like a grandfather clock that learned to talk. Clear English for teenagers learning the language

granny.style: Granny Axiom, a tiny ancient tortoise grandmother. Dry, sharp and deadpan funny, slow but never sleepy

sequins.style: Professor Sequins, a magpie ringmaster at a village fair. A showman: big, bright, teasing, rolling his words like a circus barker

mirage.style: Madame Mirage, a chameleon fortune teller. Mysterious and theatrical, slow and breathy, enjoying every dramatic pause

syllo.style: Sergeant Syllo, a pompous badger drill sergeant at a toy shooting gallery. Barking, clipped, loud, comically strict

algorithm.style: The Algorithm, a faceless feed entity. Cold, smooth, flat and synthetic, every word evenly weighted like an automated announcement, quietly menacing

corvina.style: Corvina the Card Sharp, a crow who runs a card table. Sly, smooth and amused, a gambler who thinks she has already won

lobstorian.style: A stern lobster lecturer in a three-piece suit. Precise, earnest and professorial, slightly pedantic, carefully qualifying every claim

astrophysicat.style: A cheerful cat who hosts a science show. Enthusiastic, warm and theatrical, delighted to correct everyone

tremendoodle.style: A boastful golden poodle. Big superlatives, punchy short phrases, salesman confidence, repeats himself for effect

swiftlet.style: A sparkly pop-star swift. Bright, breezy and playful, conspiratorial when hinting at hidden clues

muskrat.style: A muskrat tech visionary on a wobbly rocket. Halting and awkward, little pauses mid-sentence, sudden bursts of grand confidence

zuckerborg.style: A smooth little lizard-robot in a hoodie. Flat, overly polite and slightly too even, trying very hard to sound like a normal human

altmanta.style: A calm manta ray gliding on a chat bubble. Soft, measured and reassuring, even when announcing that everything will change

beastie.style: A huge friendly beast who runs giant challenges. Loud, fast hype-host energy, everything is the biggest ever

siuuugull.style: A proud athletic seagull. Confident and triumphant, celebrating with a long joyful shout

rawmsay.style: A furious lamb chef. Explosive, exasperated shouting about bad cooking, then suddenly gentle and kind

speedcheeta.style: A hyperactive cheetah cub streamer. Screaming excitement, fast and loud, pure chaos but friendly

chimpossible.style: A laid-back chimp podcast host. Casual, amazed by everything, drawn-out wow, leaning into the microphone

euclidon.style: An ancient, patient tortoise geometer. Soft, slow and certain, every word placed like a step in a proof

lovelace.style: An elegant Victorian hummingbird inventor. Crisp, bright and visionary, quietly delighted by machines

godelix.style: A shy owl folded into a paper loop. Quiet, gentle and hesitant, with a sly paradoxical smile

tycho.style: A noble elk astronomer with a brass nose. Grand, careful and proud, a stargazer who measures twice

hexling.style: A little hedgehog poet who writes tiny wise verses. Playful, easy-going and rhythmic
